research_rules.selection: No indicator declared validated solely by same-window ROI, early/late same-sign conditional returns, or unadjusted p-value.
research_rules.tests: 16 prespecified daily indicator families; 98 symbols available; 962 usable recent comparisons with at least 30 true and 30 false observations; HAC(5) + BH FDR across all recent candidates.
research_rules.statistical_result: No risky-stock or leveraged ETF effects survive FDR q<0.10; BIL two statistical effects around 1bp are economically negligible.
require_validation: Compare exactly the same dates in Composer
Robust to at least 10 and 20 bps trading costs
Confirm split-adjusted inceptions and historical availability
Stress one-day execution lag and alternate market regimes
Check ETF expense, volume, spreads, options IV if trading options
